These compounds are known to influence the activity of the transporter family, and their interaction with Atagabalin may modulate the transport of anions across cellular membranes. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism by which Atagabalin affects the transporter remains unclear. The evidence is consistent across different pathways, suggesting a possible role for Atagabalin in regulating the activity of the transporter family, potentially through the modulation of its substrates. However, further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction and functional significance of this relationship.
